title: Budget: interleaved min queries
prompt:
**Tình huống.** n ≤ 200000. Interleaved: `1 i x` sets a[i] = x; `2 l r` prints min a[l..r].

**Thuật toán nào phù hợp nhất? Chương trình chỉ cần in ra chữ cái.**

**A)** Recompute min per query (O(nq))

**B)** Sparse table (static only)

**C)** Segment tree with point update, O((n+q) log n)

**D)** Sort and prefix sums

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: Point updates kill prefix structures and sparse tables (static). A segment tree with point update handles both operations in O(log n).
